title: Dolphins GM Jon-Eric Sullivan: Things could go a lot of different directions with Minkah Fitzpatrick

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins GM Jon-Eric Sullivan: Things could go a lot of different directions with Minkah Fitzpatrick
sources.description: Releasing wide receiver Tyreek Hill and edge rusher Bradley Chubb kicked off General Manager Jon-Eric Sullivan's overhaul of the Dolphins roster and veteran safety Minkah Fitzpatrick could also be leaving in Miami.
